name: Ester
source:
"While he fawns over you, I’ll strike a hammerfist blow to the back of his neck!"

Main character Hazel's best friend. She’s a rock star drummer who loves the sun and chases the endless summer by traveling the globe. She’s badass to anyone who threatens Hazel.

[From official profile]
